title: Why Wednesday nights were poor
summary: Ferbos says the added Wednesday night lasted a few weeks because working people stay home early in the week.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Excuse me. I want to ask you why they played on Wednesday nights. Why would that be a good night? Oh it wasn't a good night.

It was? It didn't last long. Maybe two or three weeks or so. It wasn't a good night. It was just an idea that he had, it might work, but it wasn't a good night. In fact, really I'll be friends with you, all those places, Friday and Saturday, even Sundays were in any way. You see most working class of people, they might go out until eight, nine o'clock on a Sunday afternoon, maybe taking a shoe or something like that, but then they'd have to be to work on a Monday, so that was never a good night. Unless you played private dance, that's the only way.
Yeah. I have been to, I think the Harmony Inn at one time used to have Wednesday nights. Yeah, that's right.
